purpose: minimal multi-seed confirmation of the P4.6 A3 and B3 validation selections

verdict_rules.A3: SUPPORTED if A3-A4 > 0 for every seed; QUALIFIED if mean > 0 with mixed signs; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED
verdict_rules.B3: SUPPORTED if B3-B0 and B3-B1 are > 0 for every seed; QUALIFIED if both means > 0 with mixed signs; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED
